tool.name: lavToPsl
tool.description: : convert lastz LAV alignments to PSL
tool.command: ## ⛔ AN EMPTY LAV IS NOT AN ERROR HERE, BUT lavToPsl MAKES IT ONE: it exits 255 with "is empty". ## A KegAlign pair file with no segments legitimately produces an empty LAV, so a mapped run would ## fail on the pair that has nothing to align. An empty input writes an empty PSL instead. ## ⚠ `&&` and `||` only, no `;` and no Cheetah directive, so a UDT can be generated from this file. ( test -s '$input' || : > '$output' ) && ( test ! -s '$input' || lavToPsl '$input' '$output' )

param.name: input
param.label: LAV alignments
param.help: Several lastz runs concatenated into one file are fine: the result is the same PSL rows as converting each run separately (measured).

tool.help:
**What it does**
Converts lastz's native LAV output to PSL, the format UCSC's ``doBlastzChainNet.pl`` feeds to ``axtChain -psl``. PSL carries coordinates and block structure but no sequence; axtChain reads the sequence from the 2bit files it is given anyway, so nothing is lost -- on a real Cannabis chunk the chains from PSL and from AXT were identical, and the PSL was a tenth the size.
An empty input produces an empty output rather than an error.
.. _source code: https://github.com/ucscGenomeBrowser/kent/tree/master/src/hg/mouseStuff/lavToPsl
